title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.2.76 - Added `forkSession(sessionId, opts?)` for branching conversations from a point - Added `cancel_async_message` control subtype to drop a queued user message by UUID before execution - Added `planFilePath` field to `ExitPlanMode` tool input for hooks and SDK consumers - Added MCP elicitation hook types and `SDKElicitationCompleteMessage` system message for handling MCP server input requests programmatically - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.76 ## 0.2.75 - Added `tag` and `createdAt` fields to `SDKSessionInfo` - Added `getSessionInfo(sessionId, opts?)` for single-session metadata lookup
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
